definitions.explanation: A team game in which players throw small balls into a tall basket, common at Japanese school sports festivals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{玉|たま}{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We played the ball-toss game at the sports festival.
You throw the balls into the basket in the ball-toss game.

examples.japanese: {玉|たま}{入|い}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}かれて→分かれる：10976_wakareru⟧、かご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{競|きそ}う→競う：13767_kisou⟧⟦{競技|きょうぎ}→競技：02606_kyougi⟧だ。
examples.english: Tama-ire is a contest where teams split into red and white and compete over how many balls land in the basket.

notes:
A team game played at school ⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧ (sports festivals): players toss small balls into a tall basket, and the team with more balls in the basket wins.

HOW IT WORKS:
- ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ (balls) are thrown into a raised かご (basket).
- Teams are usually split into ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧ (red and white).
- The balls are counted aloud at the end to decide the winner.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {玉|たま}{入|い}れ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to play the ball-toss game
- ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かご⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to get balls into the basket
